scope.reason: Re-read word-processor HTML so single printed line breaks stay inside their sentence and blank lines alone end paragraphs. Re-read legacy, suffixed and Unicode Adobe Glyph List names from stored PDF bytes; extraction has no separate feature storage. A clerk's closing mark printed after the decision is read as a publisher note rather than head matter; paragraph roles have no feature storage of their own. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Paragraph roles are recomputed from stored raw through the shared Polish role grammar on letter-spacing-collapsed text: a bench's names or a signing label with its blank under the ruling sign it, and a letter-spaced reasons heading opens the reasons; roles have no feature storage of their own. A ruling opens at its first point or its operative verb, read through letter spacing; a line that only looks marked or a list the recital announces stays in the recital, recomputed from stored raw; roles have no feature storage of their own. A document titled by its own declared type keeps that title and its reasons heading as a section, a ruling sentence that opens on its legal basis is the holding, a point whose number runs on to its verb opens the ruling, the bench opens on either wording of its composition line, and the holding ends where the bench signs; recomputed from stored raw, roles have no feature storage of their own. A printed table of contents is apparatus, a block of marks alone (a lone dash or dot) carries no body role, and in the competition authority's PDFs a short line set wholly in bold between paragraphs of the reasons is a subheading; recomputed from stored raw, roles and headings have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: a docket line printed again inside the decision (Sygn. akt. I C 155/19, or set as a heading by the layout) is case-number, not a ruling point or a section heading. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: the instruction on the remedy against the decision (Na orzeczenie … przysługuje skarga, od niniejszej decyzji przysługuje odwołanie), where the remedy is filed, and every line under the instructions' heading (Pouczenie) carry no role; the heading is a section heading. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: a head-matter line a layout sets as a heading (the decision's date, who sat on the bench) is intro, not a section heading. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Printed paragraph labels are read by one grammar: a label opens a paragraph except inside a date wrapped after its day or after a word its number belongs to, sub-paragraphs (`5.5.`) open their own and count as items beside the court's numbering, and positioned-line paragraphs are read by the one line-join owner; block text, boundaries and numbers are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own. Headings are recomputed from stored raw: in a competition authority's PDF a short line set wholly in bold heads its part of the reasons also when it is numbered in the outline (1. Status przedsiębiorcy) or numbers itself (Przykład nr 12), while a ruling point, a table row with amounts or currency and an abbreviation (a/a) stay paragraphs. Headings have no feature storage of their own.
